story.title: SAY CHEESE
paragraphs_en: Minnie was a playful rat. Minnie played in mud And Minnie became a dirty rat. The other rats started calling him "Filthy Minnnie".
So Minnie stopped playing And Minnie became an idle rat . The other rats started calling him "Lazy Minnie".
So Minnie started fighting with other rats And Minnie became an angry rat. The other rats started calling him "Grumpy Minnie“ .
So Minnie never came out of his house and played with his friends And Minnie became a solitary rat. The other rats started calling him “Lonely Minnie".
So Minnie was not happy and never smiled And Minnie became a sad rat . The others rats started calling him "Unhappy Minnie“ .
Minnie met his friend Fannie. "How are you always happy?" asked Minnie. "I eat these magic cheese crumbs and say CHEEEEESE…" said Fannie. Fannie gave Minnie a bag full of magic cheese crumbs.
Minnie came out of his house. The other rats said "Oh ! here comes the Filthy, Lazy, Grumpy, Lonely and Unhappy Minnie?"
Minnie swallowed the magic cheese crumb and said “CHEEEEESE..” The other rats now started calling him "Happy and Smiley Minnie".
